title: 2.4.31 Fix the Duplicate Pairs
description: A nested loop is supposed to print each pair once but prints every pair twice, including pairs of a number with itself. Fix the inner loop's starting value. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Run it first
steps.instructions: Run the loop as it's given. Notice it prints 1-1, 1-2, 1-3, 2-1, 2-2, 2-3, 3-1, 3-2, 3-3: every pair twice, plus pairs of a number with itself.

steps.title: Fix the inner loop's start
steps.instructions: Change the inner loop so b starts at a + 1 instead of 1. That way the inner loop only ever looks at numbers after the current one, and each pair (1-2, 1-3, 2-3) prints exactly once.

requirements.title: inner loop starts at a + 1
requirements.description: The inner loop's counter b starts at a + 1, not a fixed value, and the nested loops still log each pair. Help: 2.4.24 (Nested Loops)
